correctness.rationale: R3 enumerates three distinct target incoming-edge witnesses: 51 complete types yield leading contributions (n)_6 2^(-3d)->lambda^3 and (n)_4 4^(-d)->lambda^2. The difference between R3 and (N)_3 is bounded by 124 exhaustive four-edge types whose v-point one-coordinate linear extension maxima are 1/8,3/20,1/9,1/12; every n^v p^d term tends to zero. The standalone standard-library exact-rational enumeration reproduced both finite tables and small-sample checks. All limit exponents are strictly negative for errors, and definitions, normalization and quantifiers are explicit. Finite experiments alone are not relied upon for infinity.

value.rationale: A published Poisson limit and variance convergence for non-Pareto vertices motivate the first unknown moment. Exact third factorial deviation identifies the first failure of moment convergence and a distinct rare common-predecessor mechanism, with coefficient half of the edge-count defect. This is a meaningful structural boundary of a natural count, not a generic approximation or unrelated finite exercise.
